column2: Dispose raises the flag without the compare-exchange (every Dispose runs the releaser)
the releaser does not look at the claim first (it runs the barrier and the scan after the release)
the release is claimed without the compare-exchange (every attempt that finds no call releases)
the read of the flag after the store reports the opposite
the flags object is shared by all gates (a static)
the flags object is not created for a gate
